theorems.name: Submission.imrep_measure_eq_of_represents_same_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T → R₂.Represents T → R₁.measure = R₂.measure
